Rear surface shifted 0.8 mm in X alone. No tilt, no Y: a sign or axis error in the decenter has nothing to hide behind.

Rear surface tilted 12 deg about X AND 9 deg about Y. The only system that can tell Ry.Rx from Rx.Ry, and the angles are large on purpose: at 0.1 deg the two orderings differ by less than the tolerance and the system would pass either way.
Rear surface tilted 5 deg about X and shifted (0.7, -0.5) mm in the same step. The only system that can tell 'shift the vertex, then rotate about it' from 'rotate, then shift along the rotated axes'.
